response.sql:
WITH matched_labs AS (
    SELECT l.ID, p.SEX, l.PT, l.IGA, l.IGM
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
), patient_averages AS (
    SELECT ID, SEX,
           AVG(PT) AS avg_pt,
           AVG(IGA - IGM) AS avg_iga_minus_igm
    FROM matched_labs
    GROUP BY ID, SEX
), patient_ratios AS (
    SELECT ID, SEX, avg_pt, avg_iga_minus_igm,
           avg_iga_minus_igm / AVG(avg_iga_minus_igm) OVER () AS ratio_to_overall_mean
    FROM patient_averages
)
SELECT SEX,
       AVG(avg_pt) AS average_of_patient_average_pt,
       AVG(avg_iga_minus_igm) AS average_of_patient_iga_minus_igm_averages,
       AVG(ratio_to_overall_mean) AS average_of_patient_ratios
FROM patient_ratios
WHERE SEX IS NOT NULL AND SEX <> ''
GROUP BY SEX;

assumptions.assumption: Patients are included in the intermediate averages only if they have at least one laboratory record matched to a patient; SQL AVG ignores NULL values, including when computing each record's IGA - IGM.

The overall mean for the ratio is taken across patients with a non-NULL IGA - IGM average, before excluding patients with blank or NULL sex; the final sex summaries exclude both blank and NULL sex values.
